scriptDraft.line: Another lip oil. Sure. Let's see if e.l.f. earned my $14.
I have a drawer of these. Most are sticky, smell like dessert, or do nothing. This is the e.l.f. Glow Reviver in 'Pink Quartz.'
First — the doe-foot. It's actually shaped right. Picks up enough product without flooding. [Close-up on applicator.]
Bare lips. [B-roll cut to bare-lip mirror.] Now one swipe. [Cut back, applied.] It's not glittery. It's not sticky. It's just… hydrated.
The 'Glow Reviver' name is doing a lot of work, but my lips genuinely look revived. I'm annoyed it's working.
Verdict: $14, keeps it. I'm putting it in the rotation. Link in bio if you want the shade.
